diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour
legend: Note complex papillae with hierarchical branching and epithelial tufting.

diagnosis: Gross appearance of serous borderline tumour
legend: Cystic and solid ovarian mass with papillary excrescences.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour
legend: The epithelial lining consists of a mixture of cell types, including ciliated and non-ciliated tubal-type epithelium, with stratification, tufting, and bland nuclear features.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour, micropapillary/cribriform subtype
legend: Note long thin micropapillae (>5 times long than wide) emanating directly from a stromal core.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour, micropapillary/cribriform subtype
legend: The nuclei are relatively monotonous and often contain a single prominent nucleolus.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour with prominent surface eosinophilic cells
legend: Tumour cells with abundant glassy eosinophilic cytoplasm (arrowheads) within and exfoliating from the epithelial surface. This does not constitute a micropapillary pattern.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour with eosinophilic stromal cells
legend: This pattern is characterized by individual or small groups of tumour cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm within the stroma.

diagnosis: Focal low-grade serous carcinoma arising in association with a serous borderline tumour
legend: Note small nests/micropapillae within clefted spaces (Scale bar represents 1.0 mm)

diagnosis: Desmoplastic non-invasive implant
legend: Tumour cells merge with the stroma in this granulation tissue-like lesion, in which the stromal component predominates over the epithelial component.

diagnosis: Low-grade serous carcinoma in omentum associated with an ovarian serous borderline tumour
legend: Tumour cells show haphazard, destructive growth within stroma.

diagnosis: Epithelial non-invasive implant in association with a serous borderline tumour
legend: Note detached papillae within an epithelium-lined space with an adjacent focus of endosalpingiosis.

diagnosis: Low-grade serous carcinoma in omentum associated with an ovarian serous borderline tumour
legend: Higher magnification highlights infiltration into fat by tumour cells.

diagnosis: Low-grade serous carcinoma in association with an ovarian serous borderline tumour
legend: The epithelial predominance and the infiltration of fat distinguish this from a non-invasive implant.

diagnosis: Epithelial non-invasive implant associated with ovarian serous borderline tumour
legend: Tumour cells resemble those within the primary ovarian serous borderline tumour.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour involving lymph node
legend: Papillary epithelial proliferation within the sub-capsular sinus of a lymph node, resembling the primary ovarian serous borderline tumour.

diagnosis: Desmoplastic non-invasive implant associated with serous borderline tumour
legend: Note the predominance of stroma over epithelium.

diagnosis: Micropapillary serous borderline tumour
legend: Note large stromal papillae giving rise to hypercellular epithelial-rich micropapillary structures (low magnification).

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour, micropapillary/cribriform subtype
legend: Note long thin micropapillae (> 5 times longer than wide) emanating directly from a stromal core.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour of ovary
legend: Note hierarchical branching papillae with variable amounts of stromal cores, stratified epithelium with tufting/cell detachment, and an admixture of cell types with heterogeneous nuclei

diagnosis: Micropapillary serous borderline tumor of ovary
legend: Note elongated micropapillae without stromal cores, at least 5 times longer than wide, directly emanating from large papillae (Medusa head appearance). The cells are monotonous with high N:C ratio, small and uniform nuclei with small nucleoli
